question: A non-conducting solid sphere of radius $R$ has a uniform volume charge density $+ρ$. A spherical cavity of radius $R/2$ is carved out from the sphere such that the center of the cavity is at a distance $R/2$ from the center of the original sphere. What is the magnitude of the electric field at an arbitrary point P inside the cavity?

options.D: The field is non-uniform and depends on the location of point P.
